subject.title: Control UI: Pinned context panel for user-defined persistent facts

question: Should pinned user facts be a first-party Control UI memory feature now, folded into the broader memory-file panel, or deferred behind the Control UI plugin contribution direction?
rationale: The requested feature changes persistent context and sensitive user data behavior, while current main only has raw allowlisted file editing, read-only workspace browsing, and generic plugin tab descriptors that do not settle storage, freshness, authorization, or injection semantics.

options.title: Keep a canonical pinned-facts design
options.body: Use this issue to settle dedicated storage, freshness labels, diff-preview/write-back, security, and always-injected context tests before implementation.

options.title: Fold into the memory panel
options.body: Treat pinned facts as part of the broader MEMORY.md/USER.md editing surface if maintainers want raw memory-file UX to own the first version.

options.title: Defer to plugin UI contribution slots
options.body: Wait for the Control UI contribution-slot direction if maintainers want memory/context panels to be plugin-contributed rather than bespoke core UI.

recommendation.title: Keep a canonical pinned-facts design
recommendation.body: Use this issue to settle dedicated storage, freshness labels, diff-preview/write-back, security, and always-injected context tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses gateway file APIs, workspace memory policy, plugin UI descriptors, and security-sensitive Control UI behavior where the strongest history signal points to steipete.
